Lemma
[Geodesic characterization of the right tangent] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0464 ↗ def:chow-iii-h40-right-tangent 1. apph:H.41\group Integral curves

If $\gamma $ is locally Lipschitz at $s$, then its right tangent, when it exists, equals the limit of the initial velocities of minimizing geodesics from $\gamma (s)$ to $\gamma (s+\sigma )$, divided by $\sigma $.
